literal: Those who are righteous and those who are not, that fact, by their respective legacy, will be seen.
translation: Whether a person was righteous or unrighteous will be known by the legacy they leave behind.
modern: ஒருவர் நடுவுநிலைமை உடையவரா அல்லது நடுவுநிலைமை இல்லாதவரா என்பது அவருக்குப் பின் எஞ்சியிருக்கும் புகழாலும் பழியாலும் அறியப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how to identify a person of true equity and justice. The terms 'takkār' and 'takavilar' refer to those who possess equity and those who lack it, respectively. The poet asserts that their true nature is revealed through their 'eccam', which means that which is left behind, such as their reputation, deeds, or offspring. By observing what remains after them, the world can clearly perceive their true character.
